text:
Sleep, sleep, my own dear one,

free of trouble, free of fear,

though my soul itself may not sleep,

though I may find no rest.


Sleep, sleep, and through the night

may you make less sound

than the blade of grass,

than the fleece's silk.


May my flesh sleep within you,

my trouble and my trembling.

Let my eyes close within you:

may my heart sleep within you!

translation.title: The Sorrowful Mother
translation.editorial_note: Reuses a reviewed translation of the identical source body.
